title: Set up a substitution
text: Write $$cos(x)=1+u$$ with $$u=\frac{-x^2}{2}+\frac{x^4}{24}-\frac{x^6}{720}$$, and use $$\ln\left(1+u\right)=u-\frac{u^2}{2}+\frac{u^3}{3}$$ plus higher powers.

title: Collect terms
text: Keeping powers of $$x$$ up to $$x^6$$ gives $$\frac{-x^2}{2}-\frac{x^4}{12}-\frac{x^6}{45}$$.
